question: Are all Ma Krupa projects RERA registered?
answer: Yes. Every project we launch is registered with Gujarat RERA before a single booking is accepted. The registration number for each project is printed on its project page, on the brochure and on the allotment letter, and you can verify it independently at gujrera.gujarat.gov.in.

question: What is the booking process?
answer: Book with 10% of the agreement value, sign the allotment letter within 15 days, then register the sale agreement. The balance follows a construction-linked payment plan tied to slab milestones, so you pay as the building rises, not before.

question: Do you help with home loans?
answer: Yes. All our projects carry APF approval from major banks and housing finance companies including SBI, HDFC, LIC HFL and Bank of Baroda. Our sales desk coordinates documentation and typically gets sanction within 7 to 10 working days.

question: What charges are over and above the quoted price?
answer: Stamp duty, registration, GST as applicable, and one-time maintenance deposit. These are listed line by line in the cost sheet at the time of booking. We do not levy floor-rise, preferred-location or hidden infrastructure charges after booking.

question: Can I pre-pay or change my payment plan?
answer: Yes. Pre-payment is allowed at any milestone with no penalty. Switching between construction-linked and down-payment plans is possible before the agreement is registered, subject to the revised cost sheet.

question: What happens if possession is delayed?
answer: The registered agreement carries a delay compensation clause as mandated by RERA. In 21 years and 48 delivered projects we have not yet had to invoke it, and our average handover has been 2.4 months ahead of the committed date.

question: Can I visit the site during construction?
answer: Any working day. Booked customers get a site pass, and the project engineer walks you through the current stage. We also publish monthly progress photos and a percentage-complete figure on each project page.

question: What quality checks do you run?
answer: Concrete cube tests at 7 and 28 days for every pour, steel test certificates for every consignment, third-party structural audit at plinth and mid-height, and a documented snag list closed before handover. Reports are available to buyers on request.

question: What rental yield can I expect?
answer: It varies by asset class. Commercial units in our delivered projects have run at 6% to 8% gross annual yield, industrial units at 7% to 9%, and residential at 3% to 4%. Use the ROI calculator on this site for a project-specific estimate.

question: Do you help with resale or leasing later?
answer: Yes. Our channel desk assists existing customers with resale listing and tenant sourcing at no brokerage for the first transaction. For the Orchard Villas project we also run a managed rental programme.
